verdict.rationale: CIPO's own trademarks page publishes a forecasted examination wait time: about 8.2 months for an application filed in October 2026. That is a first-party, current processing-time disclosure for trademark filings. Missing for 10: published processing times for other transaction types (patents, industrial designs, copyright, renewals, oppositions), detail on how often the forecast is updated, and independent corroboration of its accuracy.
